I am ten years old, so I help my family on our small farm here in North West Nigeria. We only have this 0.40 hectare plot, and we grow millet here together with other crops because that is what my father and mother taught me. We do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or improved seeds from the market, but we will spread cow manure on the soil like we always do to help the millet grow strong. We will wait for the rains to come and use our own hands to weed and harvest, because paying workers is too expensive for our family.
